story.text: Seven named stations, in order: the gate → assessment → understanding → the two gates → decision → the pool → revocation. The dashboard walks them top to bottom with a next-action guide.

At the gate, a spoofed identity is refused before anything else happens — refusal is itself an audit event. Then comes [[The Witness Draw]] and the probes, then [[Understanding as Key]], then [[The Two Gates]].
What the agent sees during all of this is a deliberately narrow keyhole: the questions, never the rubric. The asymmetry is the privacy argument.
